consequence.statement: The deprecated setting continues to work but is scheduled for removal in v1; environments still using it must move to ProxySecretRef.
consequence.remediation: Identify which field/key the notice is attached to by diffing the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install.yaml, and migrate it to ProxySecretRef before v1.

assertion.statement: A line added to install.yaml in flux2 v2.7.0 states that an unidentified setting is deprecated in favour of ProxySecretRef and will be removed in v1.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The added line names only the replacement (ProxySecretRef); neither the diff context nor the evidence excerpts identify which field, Helm value, flag or key carries the deprecated behaviour (no group, kind, path or component is given).; applicability: No predicate can select the exposed environments: the deprecated setting is not identified (no CRD field path, Helm values key, flag, env var or ConfigMap key is named), so it is not runtime behaviour but it cannot be expressed as a condition.
